Privacy Policy

Effective [Date]

Heirloom Paws is run by [Legal name], [Country / address]. Questions: [Your email].

What we collect

  • Free preview photo. Processed on your device and stored only in your browser. It is never uploaded to us. To delete it, clear this site's data in your browser.
  • Order details. Your name, email and payment are handled by Payhip and PayPal. We never see your full card number.
  • Photos and notes you send after ordering, through our upload form (Tally).
  • Device and usage data collected by the TikTok Pixel and its cookies to measure our ads, if you have not opted out.

How we use it

To create and deliver your portrait, provide repaints and support, measure our advertising, and keep records required for tax.

AI tools

Your photo is processed with AI image tools ([provider names]) to create your portrait. We do not use your photos to train AI models, and we choose providers whose terms allow this [confirm before launch].

Who we share it with

Payhip and PayPal (payments), Tally (photo upload), TikTok (ad measurement), [AI provider] (image creation) and [email provider] (delivery). We do not sell your data for money. Ad measurement through the TikTok Pixel may count as "sharing" under some US state laws.

Your Privacy Choices

Use the "Your Privacy Choices" link in the store footer to stop sharing your activity with ad partners on your device. We also honour the Global Privacy Control signal from your browser automatically. You can ask us to access or delete your data at [Your email], and you will not be treated differently for asking.

How long we keep it

Pet photos are deleted within [30] days after delivery or after your repaint window ends. Order records are kept for [X] years for tax purposes. Deletion requests are completed within [7] days.

Children

This store is not directed to children under 13.

Changes

We will post changes here and update the effective date.
